Apple._SignInComment: Sign in with Apple on the WEB. ServicesId is an Apple Services ID (Identifiers > Services IDs), NOT an app bundle id, and it becomes the identity token's audience - so the same value must also appear in the API's Apple:ClientIds, or a valid token is refused with a 401 that names nothing. RedirectUri must be https and registered as a Return URL against that Services ID; Apple refuses http and refuses localhost, so this flow cannot be exercised on a development machine. DomainAssociation is the verification blob Apple issues, served verbatim at /.well-known/apple-developer-domain-association.txt. None of the three is a secret. Left EMPTY on purpose: the sign-in button hides itself until ServicesId and RedirectUri are both set.

Maps._Comment: Apple Maps on the website (item 228). Every map is MapKit JS, authorised by a token the website signs, which needs TeamId, KeyId (shown beside the key in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles > Keys) and PrivateKeyPath, a file OUTSIDE the repository holding the downloaded .p8. Left empty here on purpose: the repository is public. With no key, every map says it could not be loaded.
